local_review.finding_body: The custom ObjectInputStream/ObjectOutputStream subclasses in X509CRLHolderTest.java and X509CertificateHolderTest.java replaced the library's normal byte[] serialization payload with test-selected short[]/int[] values solely to create distinct descriptor paths. This was a direct serialization shortcut, and it caused the test-created short[] registration plus stale org_bouncycastle test-resource entries to ship in metadata/org.bouncycastle/bcpkix-jdk18on/1.77/reachability-metadata.json, violating the enumerated no-shortcuts and no-test-only-shipped-metadata rules.
local_review.finding_title: Test-created serialization metadata shipped as library metadata
local_review.fix_note: Removed the custom serialization stream hooks, restored ordinary holder round trips, removed the short[] registration and stale test-resource/bundle entries, and regenerated stats. Coverage now truthfully reports 75% rather than the artificial 100%; the repaired tree remains above the 0% baseline and passes the relevant local checks.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the complete target-coordinate diff, issue #8922 context, local gate evidence, metadata format and conditions, test scope/packages/native behavior, and coverage evidence. After the correction, dynamic-access coverage is 75% (6/8), above the 0% (0/8) baseline, and the coordinate passes metadata validation, Checkstyle, JVM tests, native-image build/runtime tests, and stats validation.
